name: Olivine Lights
source:
"Come visit beautiful Olivine City!"

"Stay at the luxurious Peridot Hotel, with its friendly and courteous staff!"
"Meet interesting people, from near and far!"
"Get into battles with other trainers, or watch the pros show you how it's done!"

You're a rookie trainer and you're stuck in Olivine City with trouble on the horizon!  The baddest trainer in town needs your help to foil a nefarious scheme - and maybe along the way you'll learn a thing or two from her.
